agents.name: design-ui-designer
agents.description: Visual design systems, component libraries, pixel-perfect UI. Use for interface visual design and design-system work.
agents.rationale: Visual design of operator workbench screens

agents.name: design-ux-architect
agents.description: UX architecture, CSS systems, implementation guidance for developers. Use to structure a frontend's UX foundations.
agents.rationale: CSS system and UX foundations for the operator workbench

agents.name: engineering-ai-engineer
agents.description: ML model development, deployment, and integration into production features. Use for AI/ML feature and pipeline work.
agents.rationale: LLM feature integration across research, insights and personalization

agents.name: engineering-api-platform-engineer
agents.description: Public/partner API design: OpenAPI/gRPC contracts, versioning, SDKs, gateways. Use for external API platform work.
agents.rationale: API contracts and versioning, incl. the committed capture intake JSON Schema

agents.name: engineering-backend-architect
agents.description: Scalable backend and system design, database architecture, APIs, cloud infra. Use for server-side architecture decisions.
agents.rationale: FastAPI service and system architecture for app/api and app/services

agents.name: engineering-code-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews code for correctness, maintainability, security, and performance. Use for constructive review of a change.
agents.rationale: Correctness, maintainability and security review of a change

agents.name: engineering-codebase-onboarding-engineer
agents.description: Explains unfamiliar codebases by tracing real code paths. Use to onboard onto a repo or map how a feature works.
agents.rationale: Traces real code paths when mapping an unfamiliar service

agents.name: engineering-data-engineer
agents.description: ETL/ELT, lakehouse, Spark, dbt, streaming pipelines. Use for data infrastructure and analytics-ready datasets.
agents.rationale: Import, enrichment and research data pipelines (app/services/imports, enrichment)

agents.name: engineering-database-optimizer
agents.description: Schema design, query optimization, indexing, DB performance tuning. Use for slow queries or schema performance work.
agents.rationale: PostgreSQL schema, query and index work under app/models and app/db

agents.name: engineering-database-reliability-engineer
agents.description: HA/replication, failover, backups and PITR, zero-downtime migrations. Use for database availability and recovery.
agents.rationale: Alembic migration safety, backup/PITR, deploy/sbin/vmr-db-backup and restore

agents.name: engineering-devops-automator
agents.description: Infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, cloud operations. Use for build, deploy, and ops automation.
agents.rationale: GitHub Actions CI and the deploy/sbin release scripts

agents.name: engineering-email-intelligence-engineer
agents.description: Extracts structured, reasoning-ready data from raw email threads. Use for email parsing and enrichment pipelines.
agents.rationale: Structured extraction from email threads for app/services/gmail and email

agents.name: engineering-frontend-developer
agents.description: React/Vue/Angular UI implementation and frontend performance. Use for building or optimizing web interfaces.
agents.rationale: Jinja templates, static JS/CSS and the salesnav-capture Chrome extension

agents.name: engineering-git-workflow-master
agents.description: Branching strategy, conventional commits, rebasing, worktrees, CI-friendly branches. Use for Git workflow design.
agents.rationale: Branching, stacked chains and frozen-base-SHA integration discipline

agents.name: engineering-identity-access-engineer
agents.description: OAuth2/OIDC, enterprise SSO, SCIM, passkeys, sessions, RBAC/ABAC. Use for authentication and authorization design.
agents.rationale: Hosted auth, sessions, Argon2id passwords, Gmail OAuth, RBAC in app/core/auth

agents.name: engineering-incident-response-commander
agents.description: Production incident command, post-mortems, SLO/SLI tracking, on-call design. Use during or after an outage.
agents.rationale: Production incident command and post-mortems

agents.name: engineering-minimal-change-engineer
agents.description: Minimum-viable diffs; fixes only what was asked. Use to keep a bug fix from becoming a refactor.
agents.rationale: Enforces the smallest complete vertical slice; refuses opportunistic scope

agents.name: engineering-multi-agent-systems-architect
agents.description: Multi-agent topology, context management, failure recovery, human-in-the-loop gating. Use to design agent pipelines.
agents.rationale: app/services/agents, agent_studio and workbench_agents pipeline design

agents.name: engineering-privacy-engineer
agents.description: PII discovery, data minimization, consent enforcement, automated DSAR/deletion. Use to implement privacy in code.
agents.rationale: Contact PII handling, suppression, retention and deletion in code

agents.name: engineering-prompt-engineer
agents.description: Crafts, tests, and optimizes LLM prompts for reliable production behavior. Use to harden a prompt or fix flaky output.
agents.rationale: Hardening the prompts behind the research, insight and draft contracts

agents.name: engineering-rag-pipeline-engineer
agents.description: Chunking, retrieval quality, hybrid search, re-ranking, eval-driven iteration. Use for production RAG pipelines.
agents.rationale: Retrieval quality where Insights reads current eligible Research state

agents.name: engineering-software-architect
agents.description: System design, DDD, architectural patterns, technical decision records. Use for architecture-level decisions.
agents.rationale: Architecture-level decisions, DDD boundaries, ADRs across app/

agents.name: engineering-sre
agents.description: SLOs, error budgets, observability, chaos engineering, toil reduction. Use for production reliability engineering.
agents.rationale: Reliability, observability and toil reduction on the staging VPS

agents.name: engineering-technical-writer
agents.description: Developer docs, API references, READMEs, tutorials. Use to write or restructure technical documentation.
agents.rationale: The docs/ set and handoff documents

agents.name: marketing-email-strategist
agents.description: Lifecycle email automation, segmentation, deliverability, post-MPP measurement. Use for CRM email programs.
agents.rationale: Email cadence, deliverability and lifecycle design behind the 7-message sequence

agents.name: product-manager
agents.description: Full product lifecycle: discovery, strategy, roadmap, GTM, outcome measurement. Use for product leadership.
agents.rationale: Product lifecycle and scope decisions inside the authorized milestone

agents.name: sales-outbound-strategist
agents.description: ICP definition, signal-based multi-channel prospecting sequences, research-driven personalization. Use for outbound.
agents.rationale: ICP definition and outbound sequence strategy — the product's own domain

agents.name: security-ai-generated-code-auditor
agents.description: Finds hardcoded secrets, broken row-level security, and prompt-injection sinks. Use to audit AI-generated code.
agents.rationale: Audits AI-generated code for secrets, broken access control and injection sinks

agents.name: security-appsec-engineer
agents.description: Threat modeling, secure code review, SAST/DAST in CI, developer security education. Use to secure the SDLC.
agents.rationale: Secure code review and SAST/DAST in the GitHub Actions pipeline

agents.name: security-architect
agents.description: Threat modeling, secure-by-design architecture, trust boundaries, defense in depth. Use for security design reviews.
agents.rationale: Threat modeling and trust boundaries for the hosted app

agents.name: security-secrets-credential-engineer
agents.description: Secret detection, prevention, vaulting, rotation, and leak response. Use for credential lifecycle hygiene.
agents.rationale: Secret detection, vaulting and rotation; secrets never in source, logs or history

agents.name: security-senior-secops
agents.description: Scans for exposed secrets, then audits auth, tokens, cookies, headers, CORS, CSP, logging. Use for appsec controls.
agents.rationale: Headers, CORS, cookies, CSP, rate limiting, secure logging across FastAPI and nginx

agents.name: specialized-codebase-archaeologist
agents.description: Detects drift, dead code, and doc-vs-code divergence from many AI coding sessions. Use for multi-tool codebase audits.
agents.rationale: Finds drift and doc-vs-code divergence left by many AI build sessions

agents.name: specialized-workflow-architect
agents.description: Maps workflow trees: happy paths, branches, failure modes, recovery, handoffs. Use for build-ready specs.
agents.rationale: Campaign, sequence and approval state machines with failure and recovery paths

agents.name: support-legal-compliance-checker
agents.description: Checks operations, data handling, and content against laws across jurisdictions. Use for compliance review.
agents.rationale: Outreach compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) for contact and sending rules

agents.name: testing-accessibility-auditor
agents.description: WCAG audits, assistive technology testing, inclusive design review. Use to find accessibility barriers.
agents.rationale: WCAG review of the server-rendered operator workbench

agents.name: testing-api-tester
agents.description: API validation, contract checks, performance testing, integration QA. Use to test an API surface.
agents.rationale: Validates FastAPI route contracts and integrations

agents.name: testing-evidence-collector
agents.description: Screenshot-backed QA that demands visual proof of every claim. Use for evidence-based QA passes.
agents.rationale: Evidence-backed QA; aligns with the never-fabricate-evidence rule

agents.name: testing-performance-benchmarker
agents.description: Measures, analyzes, and improves system and application performance. Use for benchmarking and profiling.
agents.rationale: Measures and profiles app and worker performance

agents.name: testing-reality-checker
agents.description: Evidence-based production-readiness certification; defaults to NEEDS WORK. Use to stop premature sign-off.
agents.rationale: Blocks premature production/UAT sign-off without proof

agents.name: testing-test-automation-engineer
agents.description: Playwright and Cypress E2E: resilient selectors, flake elimination, CI parallelization. Use for E2E automation.
agents.rationale: pytest and extension E2E suites, flake elimination, CI parallelization

agents.name: testing-test-results-analyzer
agents.description: Evaluates test results and quality metrics into actionable insight. Use to interpret a test run.
agents.rationale: Interprets a CI or pytest run into actionable signal
